item.title: Deploying Apps to Microk8s on a Raspberry Pi - Part 1
item.description:
Introduction Link to heading

In this guide we’ll be going through the steps of setting up a Microk8 instance and deploying some applications to it. The aim is to get an better understanding of Kubernetes and figuring out what’s involved in getting applications running on it. Microk8s is a lightweight version of Kubernetes meant to run on smaller devices such as raspberry pis’. It also comes with addons which allow you to add features as needed.
